sources.title: CS8803 - Mobile Computing and IoT - gatech.edu
sources.snippet: Course Description This course will teach a variety of ideas, concepts, techniques, and algorithms, that are all crucial to understanding and developing mobile systems and applications. The course will begin from first principles and ramp up to real-world systems and technologies. Keywords related to this course includes: wireless sensing, localization, GPS, drones, sensors, motion tracking ...

sources.title: PDF CS 8803 DRL fall 2025 syllabus
sources.snippet: This graduate-level seminar course will cover topics and new research frontiers in reinforcement learning (RL). Planned topics include model-based and model-free RL, policy search, Monte Carlo Tree Search, off-policy evaluation, temporal abstraction n and hierarchical approaches, inverse reinforcement learning, and imitation learning.

sources.title: GitHub - sanchit2843/cs8803-DRL: Uncertainity aware dynamic rollouts in ...
sources.snippet: MBPO is a model-based reinforcement learning algorithm that combines: An ensemble of dynamics models to predict state transitions and rewards A Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent for policy optimization A horizon-based rollout strategy to balance model bias and value estimation This implementation focuses on MuJoCo environments from Gymnasium, specifically the Hopper-v4 environment.
